question: With the person, question and entire token multiset held fixed, does the learned recurrent model change the answer to track a reassigned consequence more reliably than the matched trained one-read control?
protocol: Select 32 previously unscored official stories from the failed terminal reader’s untouched confirmation reservation in hash order. Within each, exchange two distinct rule consequence words. Require exactly two swapped single-token positions and a different gold answer. No model outputs used in creating the interventions. Alternate original and swapped order, same free-thinking greedy decoder and score all 64 answers and both members of each pair.
gate: Require usual matched gates of eight net answers, four net probes, paired p<.05 and <=1.5x control seconds. Additionally require >=26/32 complete pairs and at least seven more complete pairs than matched single read. No fitting. Stop on warning or budget.
